title: Site-specific Bacterial Chromosome Engineering: ΦC31 Integrase Mediated Cassette Exchange (IMCE)
protocol: Prepare sterile liquid media: TY (5 g/l tryptone, 3 g/l yeast extract, 0.44 g/l calcium chloride dehydrate).
Inoculate SmUW227 into 5 ml of TY media with 50 μg/ml spectinomycin from a single colony.
Inoculate E. coli DH5α containing pJC2 with 10 μg/ml tetracycline into 5 ml of LB liquid media.
Inoculate E. coli MT6161 with 10 μg/ml chloramphenicol into 5 ml of LB liquid media.
Inoculate E. coli DH5α containing pJH100 with 5 μg/ml gentamicin into 5 ml of LB liquid media.
Incubate E. coli strains overnight at 37 °C with constant shaking.
Incubate S. meliloti strain at 30 °C for two days with shaking.
Wash 1.5 ml of culture for each strain by collecting the cell pellet by centrifugation at 17,000 x g for 30 seconds and resuspending in 1 ml sterile 0.85% NaCl; repeat once.
Resuspend pellet in 100 μl of sterile 0.85% NaCl.
Individually spot 10 μl of washed culture for each strain on a plain TY agar plate.
Add 40 μl of each strain excluding the E. coli DH5α12 containing pJC2 in a sterile tube, mix, and spot 120 μl of this mixture on a plain TY agar plate.
Spot 40 μl of each strain in a sterile tube, mix, and spot 160 μl of this mixture on a plain TY agar plate.
Allow spots to dry in a laminar flow hood.
Seal plates and incubate at 30 °C overnight.
Streak control spots and IMCE spot onto TY agar plates supplemented with 200 μg/ml streptomycin and 30 μg/ml gentamicin.
Resuspend approximately ¼ of the IMCE mating spot in 500 μl sterile 0.85% NaCl.
Make 10-fold serial dilutions to 10-7.
Plate dilutions 10-2 through 10-5 on TY agar plates supplemented with 200 μg/ml streptomycin and 30 μg/ml gentamicin.
Plate dilutions 10-3 through 10-7 on TY agar plates supplemented with 200 μg/ml streptomycin.
Resuspend approximately a quarter of the IMCE mating spot in 500 μl sterile 0.85% NaCl for isolation of markerless trans-integrants.
Make 10-fold serial dilutions to 10-6.
Plate dilutions 10-4 to 10-6 on four TY agar plates supplemented with 200 μg/ml streptomycin and 200 μg/ml X-gluc.
Incubate plates at 30 °C for 3 days.
View RFP trans-integrants under green light (525 nm).
View RFP trans-integrants through a red filter (>610 nm).
Calculate the percent IMCE efficiency as CFU of trans-integrants compared to the CFU of total recipients.
Screen for white colonies on TY agar plates without antibiotics and with 100 μg/ml spectinomycin to confirm spectinomycin sensitivity.
Incubate control streaks for three days on TY supplemented with streptomycin and gentamicin.
Expect no growth for control streaks after incubation.
Incubate IMCE streaks for three days on TY supplemented with streptomycin and gentamicin.
Observe confluent growth on the head streak of IMCE.
Note many colonies on the second streak of IMCE.
Calculate the efficiency of trans-integration as a percentage of trans-integrants to total recipients, expecting values in the range of 0.5%.
Identify approximately half of trans-integrants as spectinomycin sensitive and white.
Confirm true cassette exchange based on the identification of white colonies.
Observe discernable RFP fluorescence under green light (525 nm) for trans-integrants containing the tester rfp donor cassette from pJH110.
View through a red filter (>610 nm) to confirm RFP fluorescence.
